nome_jp: 偽りの星夜 ジューン・ブライド
testo:
■ Whenever this creature attacks, your opponent chooses 2 cards in their hand and discards them.
■ When this creature is tapped for the first time during your turn, you may put one of your shields into your graveyard. If you do, untap this creature.
Double Breaker
